description: Vertical 1080x1920 2D scene on white background, all action in middle safe band (y ~15% to 70%, nothing in top 10% or bottom 25%). Center-mid: large clear Brita pitcher outline in muted grey with blue water filling from bottom upward. Above pitcher mid-upper: big bold fg-white on dark pill kinetic title text. Two glowing impurity icons (good=green dot and accent3=yellow-orange dot) falling in pour stream. Red X over small mesh icon to show no straining.

beats.action: Clear pitcher outline pops in center-mid on frame 0 with big title YOUR BRITA above it
Word DOESN'T slams in accent2=magenta over pitcher, small mesh icon crossed out
Blue water level rises fast inside pitcher from bottom to middle
Green and orange impurity dots in pour stream snap-vanish with white flash and snap scale pop
Big accent3=yellow text KIDNAPS FLAVOR pops center over pitcher

description: Vertical 1080x1920 2D macro water scene, safe middle band only. Background soft cyan-tinted water with floating labeled dots: chlorine good=green, copper orange, lead accent2=magenta, calcium chalky fg=white. Dots drift slowly center. Mid-scene a grey sieve mesh grid swings in from right to center. End state mesh fades and cyan chemistry glow with flask icon remains. No important elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Blue water field fades in with faint drifting particles center-mid
Good=green dot labeled CHLORINE pops in left-center and bobs
Orange dot labeled COPPER pops in right-center and bobs
Accent2=magenta dot labeled LEAD pops in center
Fg-white dot labeled CALCIUM pops in lower-center, all four drift
Grey sieve mesh swings in from right to cover center
All four dots slip straight through mesh holes and continue falling, mesh shakes
Mesh fades out with red X, cyan accent glow and CHEMISTRY NOT A SIEVE text pulses center

description:
Vertical 1080x1920 3D cutaway filter cartridge centered in safe middle band, slight slow rotation. Top half: black porous carbon block with visible sponge holes (dark grey/black). Bottom half: bed of amber translucent resin beads (orange-yellow spheres). Top inlet pours five glowing dots downward: two good=green chlorine, one orange copper, one accent2=magenta lead, one fg=white calcium. Lighting cyan accent rim, background dark navy for contrast. Camera starts top then dollies down to beads.

Viewer feedback for this new version (follow it): Make this 2d

beats.action: Five glowing intruder dots spawn above cartridge and start flowing down center
Two good=green dots pulse larger to highlight while falling toward black layer
Camera focuses top half, black carbon block lights up and pores expand visible
Both green chlorine dots stick to carbon pores, stop moving and dim locked
Green taste wave icon above carbon dissolves and vanishes
Camera dollies down to lower half, amber resin beads glow and enlarge
Copper orange, lead magenta, calcium white dots touch beads, flash white and swap places
Small fg-white hydrogen dots detach from beads and float out downward as clean water stream

description: Vertical 1080x1920 3D payoff, same dark navy world for continuity, safe middle band only. Foreground center: sparkling clear glass of cyan-tinted water sliding forward with glints. Background center: dark used cartridge (black top + amber beads now darkened) holding locked orange, magenta, white metal icons inside. Accent swap arrows cyan/magenta between them. Fill meter bar beside cartridge rises to full.

beats.action: Sparkling glass slides forward to foreground center, cartridge sits behind blurred
Big fg-white SWAPPED text pops mid-frame with cyan double-arrow swap animation
Clean cyan water swirls in glass with sparkles, CLEAN IN label flashes
Orange, magenta, white metal icons rattle locked inside background cartridge, METALS OUT label
Background cartridge pulses dark red and fill meter hits full, glass stays bright foreground
